prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: portrait backdrop for Split, an illustrated beer-sipping game. New Halloween scene: Vampire's toast.
Scene/backdrop: a Gothic castle banqueting room prepared for a Halloween dinner with friends. Tall pointed stone arches, velvet burgundy drapes, clustered taper candles, dark foliage, subtle bat garlands and a carved pumpkin, moonlight at an arched window. Small distant friends dressed as theatrical vampires talk at the right rear; friendly Halloween party, no gore.
Style/medium: refined painterly travel illustration with believable materials, soft visible brushwork and natural perspective, matching an illustrated nostalgic beer-with-friends postcard.
Composition/framing: 1024 by 1536 portrait. Seated table viewpoint. An EMPTY dark polished walnut table occupies the lower 40% with its rear edge about 60% down the frame; table runs across the entire bottom. The middle 35% of the width is quiet open space for a separately rendered large glass. Put candles, Halloween props and distant figures at the left and right edges and in the background, leaving center and foreground empty. Full room recognizable above the tabletop.
Lighting/mood: ruby candlelight against cold indigo moonlight, warm ivory candle wax, rich dark wood, theatrical but inviting.
Constraints: backdrop only; NO foreground glass, drink, beer bottle, labels, typography, logos, words, interface, borders or watermark. Empty tabletop center is essential. Opaque full bleed image.
